name: tierlist-maker
description: Helps a user author a TierVibe tier list end-to-end and produce a .tiervibe.json they import at https://tiervibe.com/t/import. Interviews the user, sets up tiers, drafts text cards or image cards (including embedded local images when file access is available), writes markdown explanations. No server calls, no login until the final step.

interface.shortDescription: One prompt -> a publish-ready TierVibe tier list, with commentary on every card.
interface.longDescription: Interviews the user, sets up tiers (henz/love/custom presets + global brightness), drafts cards (text with coordinated colors, public image URLs, or embedded local images when file access is available), writes markdown commentary on each card, and emits a .tiervibe.json the user imports at tiervibe.com/t/import. No server calls, no login until the final step.
defaultPrompt: Make a tier list for AI coding models
Give AI coding models a tier list
